titles.romaji: Eromanga Mitai na Koi Shiyo: LET'S FALL IN LOVE THE ERO-MANGA
titles.native: エロマンガみたいな恋しよう LET`S FALL IN LOVE THE ERO-MANGA

description:
Based on the manga by Yasui Riosuke.

This anime has another Title that is "Let's Fall in Love The Ero-manga" or abbreviated (LFLEM).

Consists of four short ero-manga plots in a 2-part series of cute ecchi love. Funny, erotic, and sweet. LFLEM gives immense MOE doses for otaku around the world who are teased and dissatisfied with regular anime.

(Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)
